# New-ZbxSla

## SYNOPSIS

Creates an SLA.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxSla [[-Name] <string>] [[-Period] <ZabbixSlaPeriod>] [-Slo <double>] [-EffectiveDate <DateTimeOffset>] [-Timezone <string>] [-Status <ZabbixSlaStatus>] [-Description <string>] [-ServiceTag <ZabbixSlaServiceTagRequest[]>] [-Schedule <ZabbixSlaScheduleRequest[]>] [-ExcludedDowntime <ZabbixSlaExcludedDowntimeRequest[]>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A service level agreement sets the uptime a set of services should reach in each reporting period, and reports what they reached. The New-ZbxSla cmdlet sends sla.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new SLA back with sla.get and writes it. The server requires -Name, -Period, -Slo, -EffectiveDate, -Timezone and -ServiceTag; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Create an SLA

```powershell
New-ZbxSla -Name 'Business hours SLA' -Period Monthly -Slo 99.9 -EffectiveDate ([DateTimeOffset]::new(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, [TimeSpan]::Zero).ToUnixTimeSeconds()) -Timezone 'UTC' -ServiceTag @{ tag = 'service'; value = 'shop' }
```

Creates an SLA named Business hours SLA. The command writes the new SLA, read back from the server.

## INPUTS

- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -Timezone (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixSlaPeriod`: Bound to -Period (ByPropertyName). The SLA period values: ZBX_SLA_PERIOD_* in defines.inc.php.
- `double`: Bound to -Slo (ByPropertyName).
- `DateTimeOffset`: Bound to -EffectiveDate (ByPropertyName).
- `ZabbixSlaStatus`: Bound to -Status (ByPropertyName). The SLA status values: ZBX_SLA_STATUS_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixSlaServiceTagRequest[]`: Bound to -ServiceTag (ByPropertyName). service_tags of a ZabbixSlaCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixSlaScheduleRequest[]`: Bound to -Schedule (ByPropertyName). schedule of a ZabbixSlaCreateRequest.
- `ZabbixSlaExcludedDowntimeRequest[]`: Bound to -ExcludedDowntime (ByPropertyName). excluded_downtimes of a ZabbixSlaCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixSlaRecord`: Sla record class.
